text.p: Compscript Inc said Friday that it has appointed Juan Cocuy as its chief financial officer.
Cocuy succeeds John Chiste, who left to become chief financial officer at an unnamed company that is a member of the New York Stock Exchange.
The company was not immediately available for further comment.
Most recently, Cocuy was the chief financial officer and director of IntegraCare Inc, a provider of integrated health care services, which merged with Integrated Health Services Inc in August 1995.
Compscript is a comprehensive provider of pharmacy management services to managed care networks, long-term and sub-acute care facilities, home health patients and recipients of managed care.
